title: AI & LLM Solutions
summary: RAG apps, internal AI assistants, and automation on AWS Bedrock/OpenAI with OpenSearch or Snowflake.
overview: We build RAG applications, internal assistants, and agentic workflows that reduce manual lookup and improve answer quality. Stack options include AWS Bedrock/OpenAI with OpenSearch or Snowflake, orchestrated with LangChain/LangGraph and shipped on AWS Serverless/Next.js.
metaDescription: RAG, agents, and automation that ship. Data connectors, retrieval, prompts, guardrails, evaluation, and handover.

sections.heading: What we build
paragraphs: RAG applications and internal assistants with secure retrieval and tuned prompts.
Agentic workflows with tools and functions for lookups, updates, and actions.
Evaluation harnesses that track accuracy, latency, and cost.
Surfaces for the web and for Slack or Teams.

sections.heading: Stack options
paragraphs: LLMs: AWS Bedrock (Claude, Llama) and OpenAI.
Retrieval: OpenSearch vector, Snowflake hybrid search, and pgvector.
Frameworks: LangChain/LangGraph, Next.js, and AWS Serverless with GitHub Actions CI/CD.

sections.heading: Outcomes
paragraphs: Higher answer accuracy than a naïve chat, and less time spent on manual lookup.
Lower support load through self-serve answers and suggested replies.
Observability you can use for ongoing tuning.

shapes.name: QuickStart
points: Connect 1–2 sources, baseline retrieval, a simple UI, and an evaluation set.

shapes.name: Pilot
points: Multi-source ingestion, auth, improved prompts, a Slack or Teams app, and guardrails.

shapes.name: Production
points: Hybrid search, agents, observability, handover, and runbooks.

title: Websites & SEO
summary: Fast sites for individuals and small teams, with clear messaging and acquisition set up.
overview: Fast, clear sites for individuals and small teams: messaging, contact and booking, analytics, and SEO foundations. That includes on-page SEO, Google Business Profile, and schema. Launch in 14 days, with options for growth and a care plan.
metaTitle: Websites & SEO for individuals — NisCorp AI
metaDescription: Launch a clear site with contact, booking, analytics, and SEO in 14 days. Ongoing content and optimization available.

sections.heading: Who this is for
paragraphs: Doctors, consultants, therapists, coaches, and independent practices.
Small teams that need a credible site and a steady way for people to reach them.

sections.heading: What you get
paragraphs: A clear site that explains who you are, what you offer, and how to reach you.
Conversion setup: WhatsApp, phone, email, booking links, and lead tracking.
Search and marketing foundations: on-page SEO, digital marketing, Google Business Profile, and analytics.

shapes.name: Essentials
points: 3–5 pages, copy assist, contact and booking integration, and analytics.

shapes.name: Growth
points: A blog, FAQs, email capture, schema markup, and a starter content plan.

shapes.name: Care plan
points: Updates, landing pages, SEO tune-ups, and reporting.

title: Enterprise software
summary: Operations software that matches how your company runs—workflows, data, and integrations in one place.
overview: Purpose-built operations software that matches how your company runs: fewer manual handoffs, clearer status, and integrations across your stack. Discovery, design, build in sprints, then transition with docs and runbooks.
metaTitle: Enterprise software for operations — NisCorp AI
metaDescription: Purpose-built systems, integrations, and modernization. Fixed-scope sprints, weekly demos, and a clean handover.

sections.heading: What this is
paragraphs: Systems built around your operation: fewer manual handoffs, clearer status, and tools that match how your team thinks.

sections.heading: Typical projects
paragraphs: Operations platforms for onboarding, fulfillment, or partner workflows.
Modernization from spreadsheets and legacy tools to auditable, scalable services.
Integrations and APIs across CRM, ERP, analytics, and identity.

paragraphs: Frontend: React/Next.js and Tailwind. Backend: Node.js and event-driven services.
Data: Snowflake and Postgres. Cloud: AWS Serverless. CI/CD: GitHub Actions.

shapes.name: Build
